Profile Centaury is used as a bitter, including for appetite loss and dys- pepsia. Hepatotoxicity. A report1 of hepatotoxicity possibly associat- ed with the use of Copaltra, a herbal preparation marketed as an adjunct in the treatment of diabetes mellitus and containing cen- taury and Coutarea latiflora (copalchi) (Rubiaceae). A further 5 cases had been reported to the French pharmacovigilance net- work. 1. Wurtz A-S, et al. Possible hepatotoxicity from Copaltra, an herb- al medicine. Ann Pharmacother 2002; 36: 941–2.
